title: Eligibility-Transition Waiver: Amount and Limit
content:
**Clause.** On a Pre-K tuition account of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the eligibility-transition waiver of a late fee is figured as follows.

1. The waiver is worked out on the late fee posted for the enrollment's most recent billing month, the latest billing month that carries a tuition charge.
2. The waiver is 5.00.
3. A late fee on a billing month whose tuition charge carries no eligibility credit (a credit with the credit reason "eligibility established" against that charge), or a most recent billing month that carries no late fee, has no waiver at all, and nothing is booked.
4. The waiver is never more than that late fee.
5. The schedule's amounts are applied in one order: first additions to the 5.00 waiver, then the limit. Only that final amount is rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up.

## Judging the most recent billing month (hypothetical figures)

| Late fee posted for the month | Eligibility credit on the month's tuition charge | Waiver |
|---|---|---|
| 30.00 | yes | 5.00 |
| 4.00 | yes | 4.00, the late fee |
| 30.00 | no | none |
| none | yes | none |
